scenes.text: The lighthouse keeper wrote in his log every night.
Day 41: the light is working. The ships are safe.
Day 42: the light is working. The ships are safe.
Day 43: I am the light now.

The coast guard found the log open on the desk.
The lighthouse had been dark for six weeks.
